params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch strictly renames fields and their usages from non-compliant names with underscores (e.g., m_geometryCount, m_path_count) to compliant camelCase names (e.g., geometryCount, pathCount) following the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`. All changes are consistent and limited to renaming fields and their references, with no unrelated modifications such as adding or removing print statements, changing logic, or altering variable names beyond the scope of the naming convention fix. Minor formatting and comment deletions are acceptable as per the allowed exceptions.

Score: 3
